name: polymarket-btc5m-strategy
description: Autonomous BTC 5m Up/Down pair strategy bot (paper + live)

scripts.start: mkdir -p logs && nohup node bot.js >> logs/bot.log 2>&1 & echo $! > logs/bot.pid
scripts.start:paper: mkdir -p logs && nohup env STATE_DIR=./data/paper DRY_RUN=true LOCK_MODE=true INSTANCE_NAME=paper PORT=8087 STRATEGY_PARAMS_FILE=./strategy_params.json node bot.js >> logs/bot.log 2>&1 & echo $! > logs/bot.pid
scripts.start:live: mkdir -p logs && nohup env STATE_DIR=./data/live DRY_RUN=false LOCK_MODE=true INSTANCE_NAME=live PORT=8086 START_PAUSED=true STRATEGY_PARAMS_FILE=./strategy_params.json node bot.js >> logs/bot-live.log 2>&1 & echo $! > logs/bot-live.pid
scripts.stop:paper: if [ -f logs/bot.pid ]; then kill "$(cat logs/bot.pid)" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f logs/bot.pid; fi
scripts.stop:live: if [ -f logs/bot-live.pid ]; then kill "$(cat logs/bot-live.pid)" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f logs/bot-live.pid; fi
scripts.test: node test/risk-guards.test.js && node test/skip-stats.test.js && node test/live-fill-sync.test.js && node test/hedge-cap.test.js && node test/dedupe-fills.test.js && node test/reconcile-marks.test.js && node test/activity-merge.test.js && node test/redeem-marks.test.js
